stem: In the figure, \(AB = CD\) and \(AD = CB\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Triangles \(ABC\) and \(CDA\) have \(AB = CD\), \(BC = DA\), and the shared side \(\overline{AC}\), so they are congruent by side-side-side, with \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) corresponding to \(C\), \(D\), \(A\).
Angle \(DAC\) (at \(A\) in triangle \(CDA\)) corresponds to angle \(BCA\) (at \(C\) in triangle \(ABC\)), which measures \(58^{\circ}\).
So \(x = 58\). (The \(37^{\circ}\) angle corresponds to angle \(DCA\), not to \(x\).)
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert abs(d('A','B')-d('C','D'))<0.01 and abs(d('A','D')-d('C','B'))<0.01
assert abs(ang('B','A','C')-37)<0.1 and abs(ang('B','C','A')-58)<0.1
ans=58
assert abs(ang('D','A','C')-ans)<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans
